book.title: The Mathematical Theory of Communication
book.author: Claude E. Shannon and Warren Weaver

predict.question: Counting the empty root and lengths 1–2, how many binary prefixes exist?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Communication models distinguish possible messages from their statistical uncertainty.
modelBoundary: One round gives {A}; two give {B}. Each next symbol extends existing prefixes without collisions; the empty prefix counts once.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This counts possibilities, not entropy. No symbol probabilities, noise model or coding theorem is supplied.
